summary: SVG radial bar chart: concentric rings filled clockwise in proportion to value / maximum, with legend, keyboard navigation and an accessible data table.
whenToUse: Showing the progress of a few items (2–5) toward their respective targets in a compact space.
whenNotToUse: Precisely comparing close values: outer rings are longer for the same value, use BarChart.
A single value on a scale with thresholds: use GaugeChart.
Parts of a whole: use DonutChart.

props.name: data
props.description: Rings from outside to inside; negative values count as 0, max overrides the chart maximum.

props.name: max
props.description: Value of a full ring, when the item doesn't specify its own max.

props.name: title
props.description: Visible title (figcaption); names the chart and the data table.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Format of values and maximums in the current locale; percentages always use Intl with style percent.

props.name: size
props.description: Maximum diameter in px; the chart shrinks with its container.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Legend with the value, maximum and percentage of each ring.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Visual style: vivid uses gradients and glows with the same theme colors; auto becomes vivid in the expressive look.

inherits: HTML attributes of <figure> (id, style, data-*, aria-*…); the ref points to the <figure>.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the chart area, then to the table button.
Next/previous ring: highlights the ring and announces label, value, maximum and percentage.

accessibility: <figure> with <figcaption>; focusable role="group" area with a hint and aria-live="polite" announcements.
Rings are distinguishable without color too (textures repeated in the legend), and the legend reports values and percentages as text.
Data table with "Valore", "Obiettivo" (maximum) and percentage columns.
In forced-colors mode rings become Canvas with CanvasText border and texture; the active ring has a Highlight border.
responsive: SVG with viewBox: scales up to size px while keeping its proportions.
Entrance animation only with prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
customization: Vivid appearance: appearance="vivid" (or the expressive look) paints rings with gradients between --dc-color-data-N and --dc-color-accent-default and tints the tracks; in forced-colors mode it goes back to flat.
commonMistakes: Using more than 5 rings: they become thin and hard to tell apart.
Comparing items with different maximums without saying so: the legend always shows value / maximum.

examples.name: Vivid
examples.title: Vivid appearance
examples.description: Gradients and glows with the theme colors.

limits: Values above the maximum fill the whole ring (the actual percentage remains in the text).
No labels on the rings: values are in the legend, the active readout and the table.
